data.exact_reserve_text: Prior year reserve movements resulted in a GBP 1.6m release in 2015, compared to a GBP 4.1m release in 2014 (see Note 7).
data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior year development for Syndicate 4141 in 2015 produced a modest overall strengthening of reserves of approximately GBP 2.42m (gross), driven by adverse movement in some older underwriting years (notably 2013) partially offset by favourable development in earlier years. The Managing Agent reports a net prior year release of GBP 1.6m after reinsurance, reflecting that reinsurance recoveries offset a portion of the gross strengthening. The movement is primarily attributed to changes in claims development and the relatively benign catastrophe environment in 2015 which influenced overall claims patterns.
raw_causal_phrases: Prior year reserve movements resulted in a GBP 1.6m release in 2015, compared to a GBP 4.1m release in 2014 (see Note 7).
the technical result benefited from the relatively benign catastrophe environment during 2015

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was not explicitly stated as a gross figure in the movement/narrative notes (the report quotes a NET prior year release of GBP 1.6m). A gross prior year movement was calculated from the published GROSS claims development (claims triangle) - result = +GBP 2.422m (strengthening). Net and gross differ due to reinsurance recoveries. Confidence for the gross calculation is 0.8 (calculated from triangle).
